name: PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk
summary: PT Global Digital Niaga Tbk operates an omnichannel commerce and lifestyle platform in Indonesia. The company operates through First Party, Third Party, Institution, and Physical Store segments. It trades in merchandise through electronic media network under the Blibli.com brand. The company also offers logistics; trading; online financial transaction; information and communication and travel agency; transportation and warehousing; portal web and digital platform; reservation; movie playing; software publishing; cold storage; management and handling; application development and computer and management consulting; photography; and advertising services.
